raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Enabling `SGLANG_DISAGG_STAGING_BUFFER=1` with the nixl transfer backend fails at scheduler init:

```
File "sglang/srt/disaggregation/prefill.py", line 365, in _init_kv_manager
    kv_manager.set_kv_buffer_tensors(
TypeError: NixlKVManager.set_kv_buffer_tensors() got an unexpected keyword argument 'slot_layer_ids'
```

5f216fc33f (#35758) added `slot_layer_ids` to both call sites (`prefill.py` and `decode.py`) and to `MooncakeKVManager.set_kv_buffer_tensors`, but left `NixlKVManager.set_kv_buffer_tensors` with the three argument signature from #22536. Both call sites pass the keyword unconditionally, so the NIXL staging path cannot start.

## Changes

Accept and store `slot_layer_ids` in `NixlKVManager.set_kv_buffer_tensors`, matching `MooncakeKVManager`. NIXL calls its own `send_kvcache_staged` rather than the shared `PrefillStagingStrategy.transfer`, and that path does no pipeline parallel layer pairing, so storing the value is sufficient.

## Validation

Two node PD, 8x H100 80GB per node, DeepSeek R1 Distill Qwen 32B, prefill TP 2 feeding decode TP 4, NIXL over UCX. On main both roles raise the TypeError during init and the server exits. With this change both roles come up and serve requests through the staging path.

No unit test is added because the coverage gap is in fixture configuration rather than in this file. `server_fixtures/disaggregation_fixture.py` pins the transfer backend to mooncake under CI, so `TestDisaggregationStagingDecodeLargerTP` only ever exercises mooncake, and `test_nixl_backend_basic.py` sets `SGLANG_DISAGG_STAGING_BUFFER` to `false`. Can push that separately.

## Checklist

- [x] Format with pre-commit (trailing-whitespace, end-of-file-fixer, check-ast, isort, ruff, ruff-format — all pass, no changes)
- [ ] Add unit tests (N/A, the gap is fixture configuration, not this file: `server_fixtures/disaggregation_fixture.py` pins the transfer backend to mooncake under CI, and `test_nixl_backend_basic.py` sets `SGLANG_DISAGG_STAGING_BUFFER` to `false`. Can push that separately.)
- [ ] Update documentation (N/A, no user-facing interface change)
- [ ] Accuracy and speed benchmarks (N/A, startup crash fix; the server cannot start on main, and the transfer path itself is unchanged)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance

detail.title: [PD][NIXL] Fix staging buffer startup by accepting slot_layer_ids

files.patch:
@@ -621,15 +621,24 @@ def _register_staging_memory(self, ptr: int, size: int):
                 f"(ptr=0x{ptr:x}, size={size})"
             )
 
-    def set_kv_buffer_tensors(self, k_buffers: list, v_buffers: list, page_size: int):
+    def set_kv_buffer_tensors(
+        self,
+        k_buffers: list,
+        v_buffers: list,
+        page_size: int,
+        slot_layer_ids: Optional[List[int]] = None,
+    ):
         # NOTE: matches mooncake behavior -- staging buffers are now
         # created in __init__ (per-worker), independent of the kv
         # tensors. This setter only stashes the tensor metadata used by
         # send_kvcache_staged().
+        # slot_layer_ids follows the staging slot order (every k_buffer, then
+        # every v_buffer), which is not kv_args.kv_layer_ids once a draft exists.
         self.kv_buffer_tensors = {
             "k_buffers": k_buffers,
             "v_buffers": v_buffers,
             "page_size": page_size,
+            "slot_layer_ids": list(slot_layer_ids or []),
         }
 
     def register_staging_room_bootstrap(self, room, bootstrap_infos, receiver):
